description:
There have been 3 names for this Ice Cream over the years and in different countries, you can call it either Midnight Cookies & Cream, Triple Chocolate Fudge Cookie or Chocolate Midnight Cookies. 

It used to be my favourite ice cream häagen dazs made and then it just vanished. So I thought it was time to get stuck in recreate it in my musso 4080. 

What you'll need is:

Base:
300ml Milk
300ml Double (heavy) cream (ours was 49% fat)
100g White Sugar
30g Dark Muscovado Sugar
2 Tbsp Skimmed Milk Powder
2 Egg Yolks
20g Cocoa Powder
1 Tsp Vanilla Extract

Fudge:
50g Sugar
50g 70% Chocolate
15g Cocoa (drop to 10g)
50ml Milk
3 Tbsp Corn Syrup
1/2 Tbsp Coconut Oil (deoderised)
1 Tsp Vanilla Extract
Pinch of Kosher Salt

Oreo cookies split with the cream removed. 

As i said in the video, i'd drop the cocoa in the fudge a little so have put the adjustment in the ingredients list above. 

When heating the base, you need to gently increase the temperature to 80C to cook the eggs, this is just another foolproof way to make custard without tempering them in the more traditional way.
